dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト) - GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based system used in Japanese medical clinics
evidence: COPY directives with .INC files (CPRCF082.INC, CPSRYACCT.INC, etc.)
MCPDATA.INC and MCPAREA copybooks typical of JMA ORCA
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing - monthly billing for labor accident (労災) and self-pay (自賠責) insurance claims; extracts target patients for receipt creation
purpose.summary: ORCR0810 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates monthly business files for labor accident and self-pay insurance receipts. It extracts target patients, reads receipt detail files (RECE82), and processes insurance combination data for billing. It also manages job control steps and cancellation handling.

notable_features: 28 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific copybooks (.INC files)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM parsed via UNSTRING
Job management via SJOBKANRI-MODE / ORCSJOB subprogram calls
OCCURS tables for daily visit counts and insurance combinations
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
REPLACING clause on COPY for record renaming
DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes on same physical file via two SELECT entries
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) system. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of ~100KB; full program likely contains more procedure division logic. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial calculations, which is consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase style.
